In MindsEye: Blacklisted, step into the role of Julia Black, a world-class assassin deployed by Meridian to Redrock City. Her mission is simple: eliminate the key targets and shut down a deadly deal. Working for Meridian, an agency under pressure from both external forces and internal threats, every move Julia makes carries risk. Julia must infiltrate the criminal network, sabotage a deadly deal, and expose the truth.
